# R2 Living

> R2 Living is a boutique real estate developer building modern semi-detached duplex homes in the quiet suburbs north of Warsaw, Poland (the Łomianki area). Owned by R2 Capital sp. z o.o. The company builds 2 to 4 projects a year and lets buyers configure parts of the floor plan while the home is still under construction.

## Developments

- [Wspólna XX](https://r2living.pl/wspolna): Semi-detached duplex under construction in Łomianki. 2 units, 169.59 m² total floor area each, 3 bedrooms, 3 bathrooms, plots of 438 m² and 382 m². 1,690,000 PLN per unit. Ready Q2 2027. Both units available. English version: https://r2living.pl/en/wspolna
- [Porzeczkowa V](https://r2living.pl/porzeczkowa): Completed semi-detached duplex in Kiełpin, Łomianki. 2 units, 170 m² and 164 m² total floor area, 3 bedrooms and 3 bathrooms each, plots of 431 m² and 369 m². Both units sold. English version: https://r2living.pl/en/porzeczkowa
